description: This file contains functions and classes for merging and processing test report data, including report extraction, event merging, patching, and modernization, specific to Playwright test reports.

classes.name: UniqueFileNameGenerator
classes.description: Generates unique file names by appending an index if a name has been used.

classes.name: IdsPatcher
classes.description: Patches test IDs in events to ensure uniqueness across merged reports.

classes.name: AttachmentPathPatcher
classes.description: Adjusts attachment paths to point to the resource directory.

classes.name: PathSeparatorPatcher
classes.description: Converts file paths in events to match the platform's path separator.

classes.name: GlobalErrorPatcher
classes.description: Prefixes error messages and stacks with a bot name prefix.

classes.name: JsonEventPatchers
classes.description: Manages a collection of event patchers and applies them to events.

classes.name: BlobModernizer
classes.description: Converts older report event formats to the current format based on version.

methods.name: createMergedReport
methods.description: Main function to merge multiple report shards into a single report, handling extraction, event merging, patching, and dispatching.

methods.name: parseCommonEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters common metadata events from report JSON lines.

methods.name: parseTestEvents
methods.description: Parses and filters test-related events from report JSON lines.

methods.name: splitBufferLines
methods.description: Splits a buffer into lines based on newline characters.

methods.name: extractAndParseReports
methods.description: Extracts report zip files, parses JSONL entries, and collects report events and metadata.

methods.name: findMetadata
methods.description: Extracts report metadata from the first event, ensuring version compatibility.

methods.name: mergeEvents
methods.description: Merges report events from multiple shards, producing prologue, report data, and epilogue events.

methods.name: mergeConfigureEvents
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration events into a single configuration event.

methods.name: mergeConfigs
methods.description: Combines two configuration objects into one.

methods.name: mergeEndEvents
methods.description: Merges multiple end events into a single final result event.

methods.name: sortedShardFiles
methods.description: Returns sorted list of report shard files (.zip) in a directory.

methods.name: printStatusToStdout
methods.description: Outputs status messages to standard output.
